notes.title: MXGP 24: Update 1.2.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The 1.2.2 update for MXGP 24: The Official Game is out now! This patch introduces many improvements, especially about gameplay physics . Check out the full details below!

Main fixes
Physics and animation

 Grip has been generally improved, allowing for better cornering at all speeds

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280363/792c76ad9200d5903ad744205741627061e69020.gif

 Braking aids are now applied in manual gear mode
 Suspensions had a general rework 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280363/92a7eff2be5f10903e5e8cec9cb86d3c7ef18ed3.gif

 Brakes have now more power and a more neutral distribution between front and back brakes. Curves of brakes have been reworked

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280363/8bae51f363d7c54f6d16dc25940990dcd5e826a8.gif

 The pilot's weight have been improved and the bike is generally more responsive
 Noise has been added to dirt surface to add texture to the road when riding
 Pilot has more yaw control during air time
 General bike settings have been reworked to prevent falls from high altitudes
 Tyres profile has been updated to balance settings on all surfaces including wet variant
 Handlebar collision have been reduced to avoid collision on the top of other pilots and yourself
 Collider radius has been increased on the sides to leave more space between riders
 Improvement on leg movement of the rider during turns

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280363/7ff6eed3ba174b61b3b2f5c43a84ab8ab9fa4cc3.gif

 The torso of the rider rotates more during jumps
 Detection of jumps is more precise, allowing the rider to move more when doing small jumps
 Jump position of the rider have been improved overall
 Head rotation of the rider has been improved

Interface

 Rider creation have been polished overall when entering a new name
 Corrected inputs on the sticker edition screen when using keyboard and mouse
 Fixed medal scoreboard display for Last Man Standing, Trail and Enduro gamemodes
 Fixed photo mode helpers (input on the bottom of the screen) when changing controllers

AI

 General AI rework to match physics upgrade. AI has been reworked on all tracks to improved on "Semi-pro" "Professionnal" and "Expert" difficulties
 Steering parameters now depends on the AI skill level

Bug fix

 Fixed Career money checks that were present during chapter 1 pause menu
 Fixed refresh bug when scrolling through the sitcker list in sticker editor
 Fixed wrong letterng for player's nickname in multiplayer
 Fixed back to default issue for HUD settings
 Fixed helper resizing error
 Fixed Holeshot validation on all GP steps instead of race 1 and 2
 Fixed Best season score for MX2 and MXGP saving the lowest score instead of the highest score
 Fixed camera shake when resetting a race when falling with an IA controlled rider
 Fixed PS4 pro controller detection and added PS4 wireless adaptor as well as PS5 edge controller
 Fixed Ghost compatibility with DLC Fox suits
 Fixed Career crash related to private messages in the social media tab
 Fixed sticker offset when opening customization
 Fixed memory leak with stickers
 Fixed crash when deletting sticker if the player is holding the "Add sticker" input
 Fixed graphical errors on some spot of the Free Roaming
 Fixed Flyby distance view with asset cliping on Agueda and Riola Sardo 
 Fixed a crash when changing the sound peripheral in game with a fresh save file

Track fix

 Fixed floating haystacks on Cozar
 Dust trail VFX on Cozar have been calibrated to have to correct color based on the ground type

Improvements

 Career has been increased in difficulty following player feedback
 Both brakes (front and back brakes) now allow the rider to go in reverse
 Added better transition between screen in customization mode
 Modified the rider customization screen to allow the player to see the boots of the rider when customizing them
 Enheanced the quality of the pad image during the first screen of the game

notes.title: MXGP 24: Update 1.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The 1.2.0 update for MXGP 24: The Official Game is out now! This patch introduces a new track along with various technical improvements. Check out the full details below!

Technical Improvements

 Window size management optimization
 Holeshot flames now correctly appear in replays
 Front wheel dynamics improved - corrected abnormal slip behavior during brake-turning sequences

Gameplay & Level Design

 Cozar track is now accessible in all modes, including Daily Challenge (appears randomly as designed)
 Farm tracks have been updated with improved layouts
 Ghost functionality added to Free Roaming circuits in Time Attack mode
 Medal times updated for Farms, Plateau, and St Jean d'Angely tracks
 Starting grid behavior improvements
 Added track safeguards to prevent respawning in blocked areas

Interface & Controls

 HUD preset now correctly updates after resetting to default settings
 Added mouse navigation support for menus and sliders
 Fixed scrollbar behavior in Daily Challenge screen when switching tabs or accessing rules
 Currency symbol updated to Euro (€)
 Improved driver placement interface at race start
 Gamepad button display corrections

Career Mode

 Fixed helper text display in perk tutorial popup
 Improved tutorial popup stability
 Redundant medal information removed from Tutorial mode

Factory

 Removed unnecessary "Finish" helper during onboarding and pilot creation
 Added automatic scroll to previously selected nationality
 Improved sticker selection animations and list refresh behavior
 Enhanced camera panning in stickers menu with additional helpers

Free Roaming & Online

 Ghost system improvements in Time Attack mode for Free Roaming
 Added end-of-race sticker and name unlock rewards in Online mode
